name: Griffin
description: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.

abilities.name: Treasure Hoarder
abilities.description: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin’s attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

abilities.name: Swooping Slash
abilities.description: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.
